p: She is my sister: Abraham had now twice fallen into this sin: such is man's frailty.
thou art but a dead man: So greatly God detests the breach of marriage.
a righteous nation: The infidels confessed that God would not punish but for just occasion: therefore, when he punishes, the occasion is just.
heart and: As one falling by ignorance, and not doing evil on purpose.
innocency of my hands have I: Not thinking to do any man harm.
withheld thee from sinning against me: God by his holy Spirit restrains those who offend in ignorance, that they not fall into greater offence..
prophet: That is, one to whom God reveals himself familiarly.
shall pray for thee: For the prayer of the godly is of force towards God.
kingdom a great sin: The wickedness of the king brings God's wrath on the whole realm.
fear of God is not in: He shows that no honesty can be hoped for, where there is no fear of God.
sister: By sister, he means his full cousin, and by daughter Abraham's niece, Ge 11:29 for so the Hebrews use these words.
covering of the eyes: Such a head as with whom you may be preserved from all dangers.
thus she was reproved: God caused this heathen king to reprove her because she concealed her identity, seeing that God had given her a husband as her veil and defence.
had fast closed up all the: Had taken away from them the gift of conceiving.
